title: This Copper Mine Led to a Civil War. Can Reopening It Fund a New Nation?
summary_full: Rising demand for copper has fueled interest in Bougainville’s Panguna mine, which has been shut for four decades. Yet some fear a rush to reopen risks return to violence.
